verified_observations.summary: Refreshed game opened at rank 2 with 292 supplies and incident 3 available. Garage displayed pump rank 1 and 262 XP.
Mouse wheel scrolling revealed all five garage upgrades. Ordinary mouse dragging did not scroll; this does not verify touch dragging and is not represented as touch-repair acceptance.
Three ordinary held pointer clicks on visible roofs cleared incident 3 with three stars, 95% structure, 40 seconds remaining, 2402 points, 87 supplies and 82 XP.
Returning Home and reloading retained rank 3, 379 supplies and incident 4 available. The 87-supply settlement was not paid twice.
Music was turned Off through Settings. Reloading and checking Settings retained Off; ordinary input then restored On.
Incident 4 was started through Home and paused with its Pause control. Reload restored an explicit Resume screen. Ordinary Resume continued the same incident.

After reload/resume, three ordinary held target clicks cleared incident 4 with three stars, 96% structure, 44 seconds remaining, 2460 points, 87 supplies and 82 XP. Final Home displayed rank 3, 466 supplies and incident 5 available.

Menu navigation, mute/reload/restore, active-run pause/reload/resume and a second win completed with music enabled again, without the prior audio-buffer error. No subjective listening assessment is claimed.
Inspected warning and error lists were empty twice during the initial checks and again after reload, after the second win and at finish.
